import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Physical Activity Level']*2,
                             cmap='RdYlBu_r', alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep\n(Color: Stress Level, Size: Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=10)

# Add BMI category labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    axes[0, 0].annotate(row['BMI Category'], (row['Sleep Duration']+0.01, row['Quality of Sleep']+0.1),
                       fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)

# 2. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation
colors = {'Software Engineer': '#1f77b4', 'Doctor': '#ff7f0e', 'Sales Representative': '#2ca02c'}
for occupation in df['Occupation'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occupation]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'],
                      label=occupation, color=colors[occupation], s=100, alpha=0.8,
                      edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Occupation', fontsize=10)

# 3. Heart Rate distribution by BMI Category
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ca02c', 'Overweight': '#ff7f0e', 'Obese': '#d62728'}
for bmi_category in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi_category]
    axes[0, 2].bar(bmi_category, subset['Heart Rate'].mean(),
                   color=bmi_colors[bmi_category], alpha=0.8,
                   edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)
    axes[0, 2].errorbar(bmi_category, subset['Heart Rate'].mean(),
                       yerr=subset['Heart Rate'].std() if len(subset) > 1 else 0,
                       color='black', capsize=5)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Stress Level distribution
stress_counts = df['Stress Level'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = axes[1, 0].bar(stress_counts.index.astype(str), stress_counts.values,
                     color=plt.cm.RdYlBu_r(np.linspace(0, 1, len(stress_counts))))
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Stress Levels', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
                   f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Sleep metrics comparison
sleep_metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']
x_pos = np.arange(len(sleep_metrics))
width = 0.25

for i, occupation in enumerate(df['Occupation'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occupation]
    values = [subset['Sleep Duration'].mean(), subset['Quality of Sleep'].mean()]
    axes[1, 1].bar(x_pos + i*width - width, values, width,
                   label=occupation, color=colors[occupation],
                   alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Metrics', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x_pos)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(['Sleep Duration\n(hours)', 'Quality of Sleep\n(1-10)'])
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Occupation', fontsize=10)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level',
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

im = axes[1, 2].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_yticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels([col.replace(' ', '\n') for col in numerical_cols], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 2].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols, fontsize=9)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Variables', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 2].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                              ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 2])

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
